installHint: Its own window, and an icon on your home screen or dock.
iosHint: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
offlineHint: Your chats are here. Nothing goes out until you're back online.
shareHint: Pick a chat. You check it and send it there.
shareNoChats: No chats yet. Start one, then share again.
shareNone: Nothing was shared, or it was already picked up.
wakeHint: Contacts' apps can wake this one with a push. Nothing of the message goes in it.
wakeInfo: When a contact's message can't reach you because Ghostly is closed, their app sends an empty wake-up to your browser's push service (Google, Apple or Mozilla, depending on the browser). It says only that there is a new message: no text, no name. The push service learns that a push happened and when; your contacts learn your push address. Muted chats never show it. New address makes a fresh one, so nobody you stopped talking to can wake you.
wakeOnHint: On. A message sent while Ghostly is closed shows "New message".
